  1. com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.enums

Uses of Package
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.enums

Packages that use com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.enums
Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard
The Deployment Wizard: turns a metro OptimizationResult into an executable DeploymentPlan — Cloud Routers, provider connections, inter-metro backbone links, and routing protocols, with bandwidth-aware profile selection and honestly-reconciled pricing.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.model
Value types for the Deployment Wizard — the plan itself and everything it is made of, plus the execution-side inputs and outcomes.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard
Rate cards: pluggable sources of unit prices for the design-time cost, savings, and TCO models.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider
Live cloud-provider pricing adapters: RateCard implementations that source current data-egress list prices from the providers' public pricing APIs — AwsPriceListRateCard (AWS Price List bulk offers), AzureRetailPricesRateCard (Azure Retail Prices), GcpBillingCatalogRateCard (GCP Cloud Billing Catalog; the only one needing an API key), and OracleCloudPriceListRateCard (OCI Price List).
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.savings
Cloud-egress savings estimation: how much routing a monthly data volume over an Equinix private interconnect saves versus egressing it to the public internet, net of the Equinix interconnect cost.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.tco
Design-time total-cost-of-ownership comparison across three DeploymentArchetypes — public cloud over the internet, on-premises, and Equinix-interconnected.
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.client
Fabric domain client interfaces for the Equinix Java SDK.
